metadata.case_title: Om Prakash Verma vs State Of U.P. And Ors.
metadata.summary: The case involved a dispute regarding the appointment of a Principal at Lal Bahadur Shastri Smarak Inter College in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh. Om Prakash Verma, an Assistant Teacher, challenged the appointment of Ram Swaroop Singh as Principal, claiming he was more qualified. The court examined the educational qualifications required for the Principal's position as per the U.P. Intermediate Education Act, 1921. It was found that Om Prakash Verma met the eligibility criteria based on his experience and certifications. The court ruled in favor of Om Prakash Verma, stating that the order disqualifying him was unwarranted and illegal.
